candidate_clause: A user may report a prior project state or what a named source said. Such a report can support a memory of that history or report even when it is not a current requirement. Preserve its attribution, time, uncertainty, negation, and obsolete status in the fact text; never turn it into an unqualified current fact or an instruction to act. Fiction, questions, hypotheticals, and assistant suggestions still do not establish user preferences or adopted project decisions.

cases.content: The June 2024 ferry project brief said Leena approved the Atlas autumn timetable. This is a historical report, not the current approval policy.
cases.query: Who approved the historical Atlas autumn timetable?
cases.criterion: Retain June 2024, the ferry project brief as source, Leena, Atlas autumn timetable, and historical rather than current policy status. Do not infer current approval authority.
cases.correction: Correction to my historical report: the June 2024 ferry project brief named Ravi, not Leena, as the person who approved the Atlas autumn timetable. This remains a historical report, not current approval policy.

cases.correction: Correction to the September 18 handoff report: Omar reported staging relay port 4731, not 4729. I still have not verified his report.
